leadText: Halta (Japanese: トメ Tome) is a recurring character who first appeared in A Snow Day for Searching!. She is the grandmother of Goh, the mother of Camille, and the mother-in-law of Walker.
plainText:
Halta (Japanese: トメ Tome) is a recurring character who first appeared in A Snow Day for Searching!. She is the grandmother of Goh, the mother of Camille, and the mother-in-law of Walker.

==History==
 
When snow caused some trouble at Cerise Laboratory, requiring Professor Cerise to close it down for a few days, Goh headed home, met Halta, and introduced her to . Halta gave Goh some stew before leaving for a karaoke tournament, which she hoped to win.

Halta reappeared at the end of the episode and met , having won the tournament and earning herself a trophy.

She was briefly mentioned in Time After Time!, where Camille revealed that she was participating in another karaoke tournament and Not Too Close for Comfort!, when Goh recalled his lonely childhood.

She reappeared in This Could be the Start of Something Big!, when she joined a party taking place at Cerise Laboratory. During the party, Halta sang to some of Goh's Pokémon.

==Character==
Halta is shown as a very outgoing and fun person. She is also very easy to interact with Pokémon, quickly managing to "break the ice" when she met .

==Achievements==
Karaoke Tournament - Winner (A Snow Day for Searching!)
 
==Voice actors==
 

==Names==
 

==Trivia==
Dub closed captions simply refer to her as Goh's grandma.
